jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI
jobs.description:
We built Bubble with a clear mission: to empower everyone to create software. Our AI visual development platform lets anyone, from first-time entrepreneurs to enterprise teams, take an idea from prompt to fully-functional, scalable app across web, iOS, and Android. With over 6 million users in more than 100 countries, Bubble is breaking down the barriers to entrepreneurship and innovation worldwide.


Our Product

Bubble is the only fully visual AI app builder that lets you vibe code without the code to go beyond prototypes and launch real apps to real users. Chat with AI when you want speed, edit directly when you want control. Bubble's visual editor lets you fine-tune any detail, from the design to privacy rules and programming logic, so you're never stuck, even if AI hits its limits. Everything you need comes built in: a unified web and native mobile editor, enterprise-grade hosting, security, database management, and automatic scaling that grows with your business.

You can build just about anything https://bubble.io/app-gallery on Bubble, and our community is living proof. Mailead https://bubble.io/showcase/mailead  grew a $10K investment into a $2M valuation, and Faceless.video http://Faceless.video  went from zero to $1M+ ARR in under a year. People aren't just launching products on Bubble, they're building real businesses. See how Bubble builders are shipping apps that change industries, solve problems, and shape the future here: Inspiring builders, breakthrough apps https://bubble.io/customers.


Why Join Bubble Now?

The rise of AI-generated software has validated everything Bubble has been building toward for over a decade. But pure AI-generated code is fragile, hard to debug, and rarely production-ready. Bubble bridges that gap, combining the speed of AI with a structured visual platform that produces stable, scalable, secure software. The people who join Bubble right now will help define what that means for millions of builders around the world. If you've ever wanted to work on something that genuinely changes who gets to build, this is your moment.



About the team and role: 
The AI team is responsible for the generation of new Bubble apps and the in-editor agent that allows users to edit, debug, and learn about their apps. The team is focused in the following areas:

 - AI foundation: Ensuring Bubble AI has the agentic foundations to build Bubble apps effectively.

 - Building with AI: Ensuring Bubble AI has the context and tools to build functional & polished Bubble apps.

 - AI experience and user guidance: Ensuring Bubble AI offers users an intuitive experience across application generation and the in-editor agent, including educating users on what’s getting built and how best to use the editor.
   


The AI team is currently splitting into two pods and we plan to add a third in the near future. This role will oversee one of these pods - driving roadmap and execution for that area - working closely with the current Senior PM on the AI team. We will match the candidate with the AI pod and focus area(s) that are the best fit.

In addition to driving our end user facing AI capabilities forward, this role will have an opportunity to help shape how our team leverages AI internally to accelerate product and development.


In this role, you'll:

 - Drive the product strategy, OKRs, and roadmap for an AI focus area

 - Drive product initiatives from concept through delivery, balancing long-term thinking with near-term execution

 - Partner closely with design and engineering in product discovery and delivery, and with marketing and success in go-to-market

 - Leverage AI to accelerate prototyping, research and validation, engineering & GTM hand-off, and more

 - Conduct user research to validate product opportunities, and use evals and feedback to iterate on the experience

 - Clearly scope MVPs and make informed prioritization decisions while maintaining high standards

 - Mentor junior members of the team and help shape product team processes and best practices

 - Get hands-on building with Bubble to become an expert on our platform
   

About you:

 - 5-8+ years of product management experience including experience building AI products and working on end user facing products at scale

 - Experience shaping evidenced-based roadmaps and leading high-impact projects from discovery through launch and iteration

 - Strong technical fluency and hands-on experience designing, building, and improving the quality of AI products

 - Proficient using AI to accelerate product work, from capturing insights to generating documentation to creating prototypes

 - Strong product judgment: you can spot high-impact opportunities and turn them into concrete, actionable plans

 - Experience working with design to find intuitive and easy to use solutions to complex UX problems

 - Comfortable partnering with engineering: You engage on technical tradeoffs and help shape implementation decisions

 - Experience using research and data to inform product decisions, not just validate them

 - Strong communication skills for working with cross-functional teams

 - Desire to move quickly in building, launching, and iterating
   

Compensation:

We offer competitive compensation aligned to tier one markets. Our estimated salary for this role at Bubble ranges from $170k - $220k. Actual pay is determined by multiple factors such as skills, qualifications, experience and market demand.


Location:

This is a remote-friendly role open to candidates authorized to work in the U.S. Our team is based in NYC and works Eastern Time.

We're currently set up to hire across most U.S. states.

States we're not currently set up to employ in: AK, AL, AR, DE, HI, ID, IA, KS, KY, LA, ME, MT, NE, NH, NM, ND, OK, RI, SC, SD, VT, WV, WY. If you're in one of these states but open to relocating to NYC, we'd still love to hear from you.

If you'd like to join us in New York, we're happy to help with relocation. We prefer hiring within commuting distance of our Manhattan office because we value getting together in person regularly — folks who come in enjoy catered lunches, team events, and other perks.



Benefits:

In addition to cash and equity compensation, Bubble offers a robust benefits package equating to roughly twenty thousand in additional annual compensation:

Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

 - Comprehensive health coverage

 - 401(k) matching

 - Wellness and work enablement stipends

 - Generous PTO

 - A Sabbatical program



Join us!

Let’s democratize access to technology together! If this sounds like you, apply! If you don’t meet all of the qualifications but think you could be a match, we’d still love the chance to review your application. At Bubble, we encourage people from all ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Bubble does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy or caregiver status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Perhaps this job doesn't fit your background? Join our talent community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/bubble/form/bubble-talent-community!
